description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Remove R. P. N. D. Stephen from the Post of Chairman and the Post of member of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha from 14.03.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the removal of a local government official (Chairman of a Pradeshiya Sabha) following a judicial inquiry into alleged offenses. The content involves law enforcement procedures, a judicial officer's commission of inquiry, and the exercise of constitutional and statutory powers to remove an official from office. This falls under Judicial/Law Enforcement matters (Type 9) as it deals with legal proceedings, enforcement of laws against a public official, and the application of judicial authority at the provincial level.
